name: Bantu knots
summary: Multiple sections of hair twisted and wrapped into individual coiled knots against the scalp.
intro: Each knot is built from its own section of hair. Even sections give a balanced arrangement, while different shapes and sizes change how the parts and knots read across the head.
The style is associated with traditional Zulu hairstyling in southern Africa. The coiled knots can be worn as the finished style or later released to make a knot-out.

variations.name: Medium Bantu knots
variations.description: Evenly spaced sections create a set of distinct rounded knots.

variations.name: Small Bantu knots
variations.description: More sections create smaller knots and a finer parting pattern.

variations.name: Braided Bantu knots
variations.description: Each section is braided before being wrapped into a knot.

consultation.intro: Decide how visible you want the parts to be and how many individual knots will fit the available length and density.
questions: Would you prefer fewer prominent knots or more compact knots?
Do you want a grid, diamonds, or softer parts?
How should the ends be secured?
consultation.sampleRequest: “I’d like small separate Bantu knots with visible sections and the ends tucked securely, with a comfortable amount of tension.”

considerations: Make each section large enough to wrap and hold with the length available.
A section that feels tight or uncomfortable can be rewrapped with less tension.
